cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Here requires to notice,

- The order of request interceptors is reversed. Shall we keep sync and async the same?
- Once there is an error, let's break the loop. And for async chain, it is strange that the error handle can't catch errors from the success handler of the same interceptor, due to `then(f1, f2)` reason.

evidence.thread_resolution:
SashaKoro: Can you clarify the first question? What do you mean the order of the request interceptors is reversed?
SashaKoro: break added
chinesedfan: See https://github.com/axios/axios/issues/1663. It is not straight-forward, but we need to obey it.
SashaKoro: Ah, I see what you mean. It was originally reversed.
SashaKoro: Will fix
